facts.business: Vardhman Acrylics Ltd. manufactures and sells acrylic fiber.
key_risks: Global acrylic fiber industry overcapacity hurting margins
Dumping of acrylic fiber in India from few countries
Dependence on imports for Acrylonitrile (primary raw material) affected by crude oil prices and exchange rate variations
Geopolitical concerns and trade disruptions (US-Iran-Israel war) causing supply chain disruptions and price volatility
Shift in consumer preferences towards alternative fibers
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis.
